text:
```yaml
name: Android Build

on:
  push:
    branches: [ main ]
  pull_request:
    branches: [ main ]

jobs:
  build-android:
    runs-on: macos-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up JDK 8 (x64)
        uses: actions/setup-java@v4
        with:
          distribution: temurin
          java-version: 8
          architecture: x64

      - name: Set up Android SDK
        uses: android-actions/setup-android@v3
        with:
          cmdline-tools-version: 11076708
          accept-android-sdk-licenses: true
          packages: |
            build-tools;30.0.3
            platform-tools
            platforms;android-30
            extra;android;m2repository

      - name: Set up Android NDK
        uses: nttld/setup-ndk@v1
        with:
          ndk-version: 23.1.7779620
          add-to-path: true

      - name: Run workspace setup
        run: |
          chmod +x ./scripts/setup-workspace.sh
          ./scripts/setup-workspace.sh -q -DskipTests
        shell: bash

      - name: Build Android port
        run: |
          chmod +x ./scripts/build-android-port.sh
          ./scripts/build-android-port.sh -q -DskipTests -Dmaven.javadoc.skip=true
        shell: bash
```
